spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS "Total",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE wraparound) AS "Anti-wraparound vacuums"
FROM pganalyze.vacuum_stats
WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at)

spec.title: Transaction ID Utilization
spec.description: How much transaction ID space is utilized among the actual maximum available transaction IDs, in percent.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  ROUND(100.0 * age(datfrozenxid) / 4294967296, 4) AS xid_utilization_percent
FROM pg_database
WHERE datname = current_database()

SELECT
    COALESCE(
        cag.view_schema || '.' || cag.view_name,
        ch.hypertable_schema || '.' || ch.hypertable_name,
        n.nspname || '.' || c.relname
    ) AS "Table",
    COUNT(*) AS "Count",
    SUM(v.tuples_removed) || ' (' || 
        ROUND(
            SUM(v.tuples_removed) / NULLIF(SUM(v.tuples_removed + v.tuples_remain), 0) * 100.0,
            2
        ) || '%)' AS "Tuples removed",
    SUM(v.index_scans) AS "Index scans",
    SUM(v.pages_removed) AS "Pages removed",
    MAX(v.finished_at - v.started_at) AS "Max duration",
    MAX(v.finished_at) AS "Last vacuum"
FROM pganalyze.vacuum_stats v
JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = v.relid
JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace

LEFT JOIN timescaledb_information.chunks ch
       ON ch.chunk_schema = n.nspname
      AND ch.chunk_name   = c.relname

LEFT JOIN timescaledb_information.continuous_aggregates cag
  ON cag.materialization_hypertable_schema = ch.hypertable_schema
 AND cag.materialization_hypertable_name   = ch.hypertable_name

WHERE $__timeFilter(v.started_at)

GROUP BY
    COALESCE(
        cag.view_schema || '.' || cag.view_name,
        ch.hypertable_schema || '.' || ch.hypertable_name,
        n.nspname || '.' || c.relname
    )

ORDER BY SUM(v.tuples_removed) DESC

spec.title: Xmin Horizon Assigned
spec.description: How long ago the xmin horizon was assigned, indicating up to which point VACUUM can clean up dead rows.

spec.rawSql:
WITH xmin_candidates AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE((
      SELECT
        CASE WHEN COALESCE(pg_catalog.age(backend_xid), 0) > COALESCE(pg_catalog.age(backend_xmin), 0)
          THEN backend_xid::text::bigint
          ELSE backend_xmin::text::bigint
        END
      FROM pg_catalog.pg_stat_activity
      WHERE backend_xmin IS NOT NULL OR backend_xid IS NOT NULL
      ORDER BY greatest(pg_catalog.age(backend_xmin), pg_catalog.age(backend_xid)) DESC
      LIMIT 1
    ), 0) AS backend,

    COALESCE((
      SELECT xmin::text::bigint
      FROM pg_catalog.pg_replication_slots
      WHERE xmin IS NOT NULL
      ORDER BY pg_catalog.age(xmin) DESC
      LIMIT 1
    ), 0) AS replication_slot_xmin,

    COALESCE((
      SELECT catalog_xmin::text::bigint
      FROM pg_catalog.pg_replication_slots
      WHERE catalog_xmin IS NOT NULL
      ORDER BY pg_catalog.age(catalog_xmin) DESC
      LIMIT 1
    ), 0) AS replication_slot_catalog_xmin,

    COALESCE((
      SELECT transaction::text::bigint
      FROM pg_catalog.pg_prepared_xacts
      ORDER BY pg_catalog.age(transaction) DESC
      LIMIT 1
    ), 0) AS prepare_xact,

    COALESCE((
      SELECT backend_xmin::text::bigint
      FROM pg_catalog.pg_stat_replication
      WHERE backend_xmin IS NOT NULL
      ORDER BY pg_catalog.age(backend_xmin) DESC
      LIMIT 1
    ), 0) AS standby
),
true_xmin AS (
  SELECT
    LEAST(
      backend,
      replication_slot_xmin,
      replication_slot_catalog_xmin,
      prepare_xact,
      standby
    ) AS xmin
  FROM xmin_candidates
),
txn_rate AS (
  SELECT
    EXTRACT(epoch FROM (now() - COALESCE(stats_reset, pg_postmaster_start_time()))) AS seconds_since_startup,
    (xact_commit + xact_rollback) AS total_txns,
    CASE 
      WHEN (xact_commit + xact_rollback) > 0
      THEN EXTRACT(epoch FROM (now() - COALESCE(stats_reset, pg_postmaster_start_time()))) / (xact_commit + xact_rollback)
      ELSE NULL
    END AS seconds_per_txn
  FROM pg_stat_database
  WHERE datname = current_database()
)
SELECT
  CASE WHEN seconds_per_txn IS NOT NULL
       THEN (txid_current() - xmin) * seconds_per_txn
       ELSE NULL
  END AS approx_seconds_ago
FROM true_xmin CROSS JOIN txn_rate;

WITH threshold AS (
  SELECT setting::bigint AS "autovacuum_freeze_max_age"
  FROM pg_settings
  WHERE name ='autovacuum_freeze_max_age'
)

SELECT
  collected_at AS time,
  frozen_xid_age,
  (SELECT autovacuum_freeze_max_age FROM threshold) AS autovacuum_freeze_max_age
FROM pganalyze.database_stats
ORDER BY collected_at

WITH threshold AS (
  SELECT setting::bigint AS "autovacuum_multixact_freeze_max_age"
  FROM pg_settings
  WHERE name ='autovacuum_multixact_freeze_max_age'
)

SELECT
  collected_at AS time,
  frozen_mxid_age,
  (SELECT autovacuum_multixact_freeze_max_age FROM threshold) AS autovacuum_multixact_freeze_max_age
FROM pganalyze.database_stats
ORDER BY collected_at

spec.title: Max read I/O impact
spec.description: Theoretical maximum impact that VACUUM can have on your system

spec.rawSql:
WITH settings AS (
  SELECT
    (CASE 
       WHEN (SELECT setting FROM pg_settings WHERE name = 'autovacuum_vacuum_cost_limit') = '-1'
       THEN (SELECT setting::numeric FROM pg_settings WHERE name = 'vacuum_cost_limit')
       ELSE (SELECT setting::numeric FROM pg_settings WHERE name = 'autovacuum_vacuum_cost_limit')
     END) AS vacuum_cost_limit_effective,
    (SELECT setting::numeric FROM pg_settings WHERE name = 'vacuum_cost_page_miss') AS vacuum_cost_page_miss,
    (SELECT setting::numeric FROM pg_settings WHERE name = 'autovacuum_vacuum_cost_delay') AS autovacuum_vacuum_cost_delay,
    8192 AS block_size_bytes -- 8kB block size
)
SELECT
  (vacuum_cost_limit_effective / vacuum_cost_page_miss * block_size_bytes / autovacuum_vacuum_cost_delay) * 1000 AS max_vacuum_read_rate_bytes_per_sec
FROM settings

spec.title: Max write I/O impact
spec.description: Theoretical maximum impact that VACUUM can have on your system

spec.rawSql:
WITH settings AS (
  SELECT
    (CASE 
       WHEN (SELECT setting FROM pg_settings WHERE name = 'autovacuum_vacuum_cost_limit') = '-1'
       THEN (SELECT setting::numeric FROM pg_settings WHERE name = 'vacuum_cost_limit')
       ELSE (SELECT setting::numeric FROM pg_settings WHERE name = 'autovacuum_vacuum_cost_limit')
     END) AS vacuum_cost_limit_effective,
    (SELECT setting::numeric FROM pg_settings WHERE name = 'vacuum_cost_page_dirty') AS vacuum_cost_page_dirty,
    (SELECT setting::numeric FROM pg_settings WHERE name = 'autovacuum_vacuum_cost_delay') AS autovacuum_vacuum_cost_delay,
    8192 AS block_size_bytes -- 8kB block size
)
SELECT
  (vacuum_cost_limit_effective / vacuum_cost_page_dirty * block_size_bytes / autovacuum_vacuum_cost_delay) * 1000 AS max_vacuum_write_rate_bytes_per_sec
FROM settings

spec.title: Est. Table Bloat
spec.description: The estimated overall table bloat on this server or database - this is a very rough estimate and should be reviewed for individual tables. Only tables > 64kB are considered

spec.rawSql:
WITH tables AS (
  SELECT schemaname, tablename
  FROM pg_tables
  WHERE schemaname NOT SIMILAR TO '(pg_catalog|information_schema%)'
),
bloat_data AS (
  SELECT
    stats.table_len,
    (stats.dead_tuple_len)::numeric AS bloat_bytes,
    ((stats.dead_tuple_len)::numeric / NULLIF(stats.table_len, 0)) AS bloat_ratio
  FROM tables t,
  LATERAL pgstattuple_approx(format('%I.%I', t.schemaname, t.tablename)) stats
  WHERE stats.table_len >= 65536 -- 64kb min
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(SUM(bloat_bytes), 0) AS total_bloat,
  COALESCE(ROUND(100.0 * AVG(bloat_ratio), 2), 0) AS avg_bloat_percent
FROM bloat_data
WHERE bloat_ratio IS NOT NULL;

spec.title: Total tables
spec.description: The total number of tables on this database - databases with a lot of tables can often times suffer from more autovacuum scheduling challenges.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_tables
FROM pg_tables
WHERE schemaname NOT SIMILAR TO '(pg_catalog|information_schema|_timescaledb%)'

SELECT
    name,
    setting
  FROM pg_settings
  WHERE name IN (
    'autovacuum_max_workers',
    'autovacuum_vacuum_cost_delay',
    'autovacuum_vacuum_threshold',
    'autovacuum_freeze_max_age',
    'autovacuum_vacuum_insert_threshold',
    'autovacuum_vacuum_cost_limit',
    'autovacuum_vacuum_scale_factor',
    'autovacuum_multixact_freeze_max_age',
    'autovacuum_vacuum_insert_scale_factor',
    'autovacuum_naptime',
    'autovacuum_work_mem'
  )

WITH per_table_options AS (
  SELECT
    n.nspname AS schema,
    c.relname AS tbl,
    opt.option_name,
    opt.option_value
  FROM pg_class c
  JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL pg_options_to_table(c.reloptions) AS opt
  WHERE c.relkind = 'r' -- only tables
    AND n.nspname NOT LIKE '\_timescaledb%'
),

effective_options AS (
  SELECT
    t.schema,
    t.tbl,
    COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN o.option_name = 'autovacuum_vacuum_scale_factor' THEN o.option_value END), '[default]') AS table_scale_factor,
    COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN o.option_name = 'autovacuum_vacuum_threshold' THEN o.option_value END), '[default]') AS table_threshold
  FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT n.nspname AS schema, c.relname AS tbl
    FROM pg_class c
    JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
    WHERE c.relkind = 'r'
      AND n.nspname NOT SIMILAR TO '(pg_catalog|information_schema|_timescaledb%)'
  ) t
  LEFT JOIN per_table_options o ON o.schema = t.schema AND o.tbl = t.tbl
  GROUP BY t.schema, t.tbl
),

table_sizes AS (
  SELECT 
    t.schemaname AS schema,
    t.relname AS tbl,
    CASE 
      WHEN ht.hypertable_name IS NOT NULL THEN hypertable_size(ht.hypertable_schema || '.' || ht.hypertable_name)
      ELSE pg_total_relation_size(t.schemaname || '.' || t.relname)
    END AS table_size_bytes
  FROM pg_stat_user_tables t
  LEFT JOIN timescaledb_information.hypertables ht
    ON ht.hypertable_schema = t.schemaname
   AND ht.hypertable_name = t.relname
  WHERE t.schemaname NOT LIKE '\_timescaledb%'
),

bloat_stats AS (
  SELECT
    schema,
    tbl,
    SUM(bloat_bytes) AS dead_bytes
  FROM (
    -- normal tables
    SELECT
      n.nspname AS schema,
      c.relname AS tbl,
      (stats.dead_tuple_len)::numeric AS bloat_bytes
    FROM pg_class c
    JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL pgstattuple_approx(format('%I.%I', n.nspname, c.relname)) AS stats
    WHERE c.relkind = 'r'
      AND n.nspname NOT SIMILAR TO '(pg_catalog|information_schema|_timescaledb%)'

    UNION ALL

    -- hypertable chunks
    SELECT
      ch.hypertable_schema AS schema,
      ch.hypertable_name AS tbl,
      (stats.dead_tuple_len)::numeric AS bloat_bytes
    FROM timescaledb_information.chunks ch
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL pgstattuple_approx(format('%I.%I', ch.chunk_schema, ch.chunk_name)) AS stats
  ) sub
  GROUP BY schema, tbl
),

vacuum AS (
  SELECT
      COALESCE(c.hypertable_schema, t.schemaname) AS schema,
      COALESCE(c.hypertable_name, t.relname)      AS tbl,
      t.last_vacuum,
      t.last_autovacuum
  FROM pg_stat_user_tables t
  LEFT JOIN timescaledb_information.chunks c
    ON c.chunk_schema = t.schemaname
    AND c.chunk_name   = t.relname
  WHERE COALESCE(c.hypertable_schema, t.schemaname)
        IN ('public', 'pganalyze', 'uec')
),

last_vacuum AS (
  SELECT
      schema,
      tbl,
      MAX(last_vacuum)     AS last_vacuum,
      MAX(last_autovacuum) AS last_autovacuum
  FROM vacuum
  GROUP BY schema, tbl
  ORDER BY last_autovacuum DESC NULLS LAST
)

SELECT
  eo.schema AS "Schema",
  eo.tbl AS "Table",
  eo.table_scale_factor AS "Scale factor",
  eo.table_threshold AS "Threshold",
  ts.table_size_bytes AS "Data size",
  bs.dead_bytes AS "Est. bloat",
  ROUND(bs.dead_bytes / NULLIF(ts.table_size_bytes,0) * 100, 2) AS "Est. bloat %",
  GREATEST(lv.last_vacuum, lv.last_autovacuum) AS "Last vacuumed"
FROM effective_options eo
LEFT JOIN table_sizes ts ON ts.schema = eo.schema AND ts.tbl = eo.tbl
LEFT JOIN bloat_stats bs ON bs.schema = eo.schema AND bs.tbl = eo.tbl
LEFT JOIN last_vacuum lv ON lv.schema = eo.schema AND lv.tbl = eo.tbl
ORDER BY eo.schema, eo.tbl;

spec.title: Anti-Wraparound Frequency
spec.description: How often an Anti-Wraparound VACUUM is estimated to be scheduled on average from all tables - this is a function of the rate of transaction ID consumption, as well as the autovacuum_freeze_max_age and vacuum_freeze_min_age settings. Higher values are better.

spec.rawSql:
WITH params AS (
  SELECT
    c.oid,
    (c.relfrozenxid::text)::bigint AS relfrozenxid_int,
    txid_current() AS current_xid,
    (SELECT setting::bigint FROM pg_settings WHERE name = 'autovacuum_freeze_max_age') AS freeze_max_age,
    ((d.xact_commit + d.xact_rollback) / NULLIF(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - COALESCE(d.stats_reset, pg_postmaster_start_time()))),0)) AS xid_per_sec
  FROM pg_class c
  CROSS JOIN pg_stat_database d
  WHERE d.datname = current_database()
    AND c.relkind = 'r'
)
SELECT
  AVG(
    CASE
      WHEN xid_per_sec > 0 THEN
        (freeze_max_age - (current_xid - relfrozenxid_int)) / xid_per_sec / 3600
      ELSE NULL
    END
  ) AS avg_hours_until_anti_wraparound_vacuum
FROM params;

spec.title: Transaction ID Allocation
spec.description: The rate of transaction IDs that are allocated per minute, as averaged over the last 24 hours. Higher allocation rates generally mean more freezing will be required.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  ROUND(
    ((xact_commit + xact_rollback) / (LEAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - COALESCE(stats_reset, pg_postmaster_start_time())), 24 * 3600) / 60.0))::numeric,
    2
  ) AS txn_id_allocation_per_minute_24h_avg
FROM pg_stat_database
WHERE datname = current_database()
